name: Minor Chaos Elemental
description: A coruscating mass of uncontrollable magic.

abilities.name: Arcane Form
abilities.description: The Elemental is resistant to magic damage.

abilities.name: Sickening Flux
abilities.description: Mark a HP to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until their next rest or they clear a HP.

abilities.name: Remake Reality
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to transform the area within Very Close range into a different biome. All targets within this area take 2d6+3 direct magic damage.

abilities.name: Magical Reflection
abilities.description: When the Elemental takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal an amount of damage to the attacker equal to half the damage they dealt.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
